title: Status properties/UnavailableInActiveRoll
html:
See also Status properties.

UnavailableInActiveRoll is a status property.

List of conditions with UnavailableInActiveRoll

Condition Effects
Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Cloak of Shadows
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.
  • Attacking, casting spells, or entering a brightly lit area ends this condition.
Defensive Protocol: Bulwark
  • While in this defensive state, the Steel Watcher becomes  Unyielding and can use its  Repair Matrix,  Hellfire Missiles and  Repelling Protocol.
  • Also grants  75 temporary hit points.
  • If the Steel Watcher loses these temporary hit points, he automatically uses  Terminate Bulwark Protocol and loses this condition.
  • If hit by a  Flashblinder, the Steel Watcher loses this condition.
Detonation Impending!
  • This Steel Watcher is preparing to  Self-Detonate.
Frenzied
  • Deal an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Gloomweave
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Attacking or casting spells that are not Shadowslip ends this condition.
Greater Invisibility
  • Entity has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls. Attack Rolls against it have  Disadvantage
  • When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt.
Hide in Plain Sight
  • Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls. It has a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Invisible
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.
  • Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.
One with the Shadows
  • Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Rage
  • Deals an additional 2 + 1d4⁠⁠Slashing[See Notes] damage with melee attacks.
  • Is  Enlarged[See Notes].
  • Has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
  • Can use  Frenzied Strike (Boar).
  • Rage ends early if the boar didn't attack an enemy or take damage since its last turn.
Rage: Bear Heart
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to all damage except ⁠Psychic damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Eagle Heart
  • Can use  Dash as a  Bonus Action, and foes have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Elk Heart
  • Movement speed increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and can use  Primal Stampede.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Tiger Heart
  • Jump distance increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and can use  Tiger's Bloodlust.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Wolf Heart
  • Can use  Inciting Howl and allies have  Advantage on melee  Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft).
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Umbral Shroud
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.
